faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about admissions, sponsorship grants, direct tutoring, and campus intranet access.

items.question: Who is eligible for scholarship and sponsorship grants?
items.answer: Applicants demonstrating strong commitment to tech leadership and problem-solving within their communities can qualify for 100% subsidized tuition. Check eligibility via the Tuition & Plans page.

items.question: What is the Dual-Signoff Rule in Direct Tutoring?
items.answer: Attendance and credit for direct 1-on-1 tutoring sessions are strictly validated only when both the student fellow and the assigned instructor have checked and signed off on the session ledger.

items.question: How does the Campus Intranet partition differ from the Public Catalog?
items.answer: The Public Catalog is open to everyone to inspect course outlines and preview lessons. The Campus Intranet is a secured environment containing timed CBT exams, live meeting studios, and official academic records.

items.question: Are certificates accredited and verifiable?
items.answer: Yes! Every course certificate is issued upon 100% curriculum completion and includes a unique verification hash and digital registrar signature.
